actionable_findings.status: witnessed; minimal stage-only candidate supplied for parent integration
actionable_findings.problem: The original20-component science guard omits the source-cell map and rebuild reader. main parses the map before even that guard, then accepts the reader/map currently present and merely records their new hashes. Accidental map/helper version drift therefore need not stop fixed-original replay preparation.
actionable_findings.actual_witness: Exact20 science components plus the unchanged original reader and a deliberately empty synthetic map produced PREPARED_ONLY with0curves and original_execution_protocol_sha256 equal to64zeros. A newline-only changed map or reader also passes the old20 guard. No material source bytes or model computations were used.
actionable_findings.mitigation: Running the normal full verify_checkpoint.py first catches map drift; an actual byte-copy fixture confirmed nonzero exit and Changed SOURCE_CELL_MAP. The direct replay command examples do not make this a mandatory precondition, and the standalone guard advertises fixed-original binding, so the entry point should reject drift itself.
actionable_findings.minimal_fix: Pin exact original SHA256 of SOURCE_CELL_MAP.json and rebuild_inputs.py at canonical study-relative paths, validate both before map JSON parse or helper import, and include the two-asset validation receipt in each new protocol. Preserve the original20 scientific component manifest and all original results.
actionable_findings.checks: 6candidatepositive/negative data-freefixtures,2old-guard drift witnesses and1AST ordering check passed. Candidate main/rebuilder/model/scorer was never executed.
actionable_findings.impact_on_existing_scientific_results: None identified. Original fixed46curve execution had its exact map, reader and20 science components; this guard omission does not invalidate those scores or numerical audits.
actionable_findings.scope_limit: Ordinary accidental/version drift protection; not a claim to harden arbitrary hostile code or authenticate mutable manifests cryptographically.

static_and_existing_receipt_review: Current six-anchor generated-curve entry: exact-key/type/positive/finite/support and log-alias contracts, observed identity handling, joint Cholesky and analytic-vs-MonteCarlo summaries
Gaussian code replacement, full covariance/residual construction, parameter derivatives and centered conditional objective source
Frozen saved-score weighting arithmetic and strict input hash
Saved-score replay integrity-test and I/O source
Fixed external runner/scorer source and roster/cohort freeze gates
Checkpoint/runtime bindings and exact20-component replay guard
coverage.new_checks: Only data-free preparation-drift witness, guard fixtures and full-checkpoint mitigation fixture. Existing10inference/33numeric and prior19guard receipts were read, not re-executed or counted as new tests.
limitations: No exhaustive fuzzing or proof that all possible defects are absent.
No new qualification of arbitrary malformed model schemas, legacy alternative runtime heads or resource-heavy workloads.
No material fit, inference, target score, raw target or hiddenS access. Models/scientific code were copied/read as bytes for fixture/hash verification only.

important_non_defects: Fixed-seed Cholesky draws need not permute samplewise with target order; analytic marginal laws are the relevant invariant.
Separate target-batch calls preserve marginal laws but not between-batch random coupling.
Exactly stored anchors repeat the same reported observation rather than a new physical replicate.
A frozen Gaussian conditional covariance need not depend on observed numerical values; this is an acknowledged statistical assumption, not an implementation bug.
Proper marginal CRPS may rank differently from coverage, joint density, point error or a different material-population weighting.
Deployment weights trained on all originalP/allowedS anchors are not the paper outer-fold weights.
not_repairable_by_code_only: Independent material/batch generalization, reserved-cohort calibration and actual laboratory saving require matching new evidence.

Parameter uncertainty, constrained endpoints and cross-source physical-state confounding are already model/study limitations. Adding a new model or calibrating on consumed targets would not independently validate the claim.
